node.title: Re: eval NoOp on cmd.exe line expr
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
This reminds me of Larry Wall's rename script, which at least on Debian systems comes with the default Perl install, at /usr/bin/prename. As far as I can tell, that's been extended upon and turned into [mod://File::Rename]. Perhaps that could serve as some inspiration?

As for what appears to be the followup question [id://1184586|here], I think it would probably indeed be best if you could post this in a new thread, along with code that demonstrates the problem ([id://174051]).
